functional_changes: Added a separate 10-band target-ratio reference setting page; the target is persisted in QSettings and does not add JSON files to config.
Added a separate ratio-EQ optimizer; the existing target_db/tolerance_db/priority_weight analysis and judgment path remains intact.
Initial dB correction is 10*log10(Target/Pre). Closed-loop correction uses the actual STFT/post-occupancy response and a numerical Jacobian with damped least-squares updates.
Post % is recalculated from the 0.01 dB-rounded EQ values that are displayed/saved, so the reported result is self-consistent.
Added result dialog showing Pre %, Target %, Post %, residual Diff % and the final 10-band Bell EQ gains.
